notes.title: Camping Simulator: The Squad Full Release V1.1.0.0 is Here!
notes.notes:
Camping Simulator: The Squad has officially launched its full version. After a long and challege early access period filled with invaluable player feedback, the game is now packed with enhanced features and refined mechanics, offering an unparalleled camping and survival experience.

Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of nature while putting your survival skills to the test. Each campsite brings new challenges and adventures to discover:

Story Mode: Embark on a journey to find your friends and make your way back to civilization.
Dynamic Gameplay: Face changing weather, wildlife encounters, and resource management that keeps every playthrough unique.
Co-op Fun: Team up with friends or go solo to tackle the wilderness.
Whether you’re a casual camper or a survival enthusiast, Camping Simulator: The Squad offers something for everyone. Get ready to set up camp, face the wild, and create unforgettable memories.

Available now on Steam—your next great adventure awaits! 🌲🔥

NEWS V1.1.0.0

New Story Mode (3 Chapters)
Complete Keybinding system.
Lockpick loot system.
Full Gamepad support.
New craftable items. New loots.
New heatsource system.
New dynamic ve adaptive temperature system.
Enhanced Sound FX.
New interactions with nature. (Using heat sources)
New Living Habitat (A new habitat with a variety of over 20 living animals)
You are not the only danger to the hunters. This world is also alive in itself!
Major defensive mechanic: fire sources! Craft a campfire or torch to keep animals away.
Widescreen support.

notes.title: BBQ Simulator: The Squad Release
notes.notes:
Hello campers and simulator enthusiasts,

as you know Camping Simulator is still on development stage but we were already developing a new game with our team. BBQ Simulator: The Squad is a 1-8 player online party game. With different modes, you can have a BBQ party with your friends and complete a challenge. 

Gather your friends, light the BBQ up and let the feast begin!

[h3]Date:[/h3]
Race against your friends, cook the meat, impress the anime girl *Kawai*

[h3]BBQ Royale:[/h3]
Equip your tongs, loot beef, load your blowtorch and BBQ for your life in a survival environment. 

[h3]Russian Bear:[/h3]
Aim is survive. An angry Russian bear roaming around. Make some bbq before the bear turn crazy!

[h3]BBQ On Mars:[/h3]
It is a small step for a man, one giant leap for BBQ. Bring your tongs to Mars.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755350

notes.title: New Roadmap - Expanding Update - Kayaking
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Dear Campers![/b]

We hope you are having a great camping experience. We would like to share with you our new roadmap as a result of the feedback we received from the campers. We are now planning to add a major expansion pack and kayaking system for Camping Simulator. In this package, the map will expand and you will be able to explore new areas of the map with your friends by crafting canoes to the areas where you can explore and camp. As you know we just released the "Save" The Nature update which contains most wanted feature; “Save” system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40075901/39fa6a92a6662ae9ac3280bd64b5b6ca261a14a8.png[/img]

We are improving the gameplay according to user feedback. This update package will also fix the game bugs. We will add a storage system to solve the bag capacity problems. We have also updated the interaction system to increase the game experience. 

-Kayaking
-Forest map expansion.
-New regions.
-New animals. (Crocodile, Monkeys)
-New craftable items.
-More dynamic environment.
-New tent options. (New model and colors, bigger tents)
-Improved outline system. (For Interactions)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40075901/a9a70728791446c3ddaaed8ef3ef8159fcf6046d.png[/img]

Don’t forget to join our Discord community to have a talk with us, give feedback and help us on our development process.

notes.title: "Save" The Nature Update Release
notes.notes:
Hello Campers,

We hope you are having a great camping adventure. We know you have been waiting for the new update for a long time, but “Save” The Nature update has great technical difficulties that we have to solve. But finally, after a long development process, we are ready to release the most wanted feature; “Save” system.  

So what should you expect from our new save system?

It is designed for having a continuous adventure with your friends on singleplayer or multiplayer. Regardless of the player's role (client or server host), everyone can save the current game on a campfire or on a sleeping bag. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40075901/d060ba10eabaef326bdb6324ba90895331a77b87.png[/img]

Every player data that has been on the server always stays saved on a save file regardless of the player that saves. So each player can continue playing without worrying about losing the data.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40075901/505f8232e70bc6130d5533466c7da415f2639b7d.png[/img]

We hope you always enjoy being in nature and camping with your friends.

P.S: More content will be added with more regular updates. Stay tuned!

notes.title: "Save" The Nature Update
notes.notes:
Hello campers!

We published our first update several days ago which contains new content, a new map and many improvements. That was a small update we had planned before the release which shaped it with your feedback and added many features you have requested. Now it is time for more updates with much more content. 

	And here is our next update’s title: “Save” The Nature! With this update we plan to add the most wanted feature, save system. Finally you will save your progress and continue to play with your friends. We even plan to add more content which will be leaked soon. Currently we can’t give you an ETA but it won’t take long.
	
	Our aim is to have a more alive world with more content with more interactive mechanics. As we said before, it is just a beginning for us. We know what a camper expects from a camping game. With updates; bushcrafting, more interactive gameplay, more resources, a variety of items like backpacks, tents etc. is going to be added. 

	Don’t forget to join our Discord community to have a talk with us, give feedback and help us on our development process. 

https://discord.gg/4ewb9k2dVe

notes.title: Marshmallow Update and Roadmap Planning
notes.notes:
Hello campers! We are having a great launching experience and having you feedback. We know you want more content and we will not disappoint you. So to show our encourage on developing Camping Simulator: The Squad, we are preparing our first update “Marshmallow”. 

We know the shortcoming of the game and prepare an update according to those. Like all campers say, you are not camping if you don’t have a marshmellow. So with the update we are adding more content about camping. It is a minor update and includes a map that we have already started to develop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40075901/dc1af8b566df0b6d1fb2d68e10925529646be5c6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] A new map for canyoners
[*] Marshmallow cooking
[*] Friendly mode (for people who just want to chill than survive)
[*] New natural resources (berries, apples and more)
[*] A clock that shows day night cycle
[*] Localization improvements
[/list]

And tons of bug fixes. 

“Marshmallow” update is a short term goal for us which we have to release in 2 weeks on worst case. The most important thing for developing an Early Access game is having a roadmap. Currently we are preparing a mid and long term roadmap for the Camping Simulator and others titles we aim to develop. But shaping our roadmap accourding to your feedback is the most important part of the planning for us. Before announcing it, we want your help. Send your feedback, possible improvements and most importantly the content you campers want. Send it as a discussion post or as a review or you can join our Discord community and let's have a talk about your opinions. Be part of our community!

Here is the Discord channel

https://discord.gg/4ewb9k2dVe

PS: We need translators. Please join the Discord channel so you can help us with translations.

Have a peaceful camp
